query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'invoice_delivery_id',id,'invoice_id',invoice_id,'status',CASE WHEN status IN ('running','sending') THEN 'queued' ELSE status END,'created_at',created_at) AS "task!" FROM invoice_deliveries WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND status IN ('queued','running','sending','unknown') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
